name: Molly Downes
source: A fortune teller who is quite mysterious and taciturn, yet also very kind. She is especially popular with the students in at the institute, as Molly works there during holidays, giving the students a prediction of their future. At times, she also works as a teacher at the insitute, specially teaching things such as herbalism.
